subject: plotting Qualia structure to understand the Emotional circuit of brain in R-project

messages.subject: plotting Qualia structure to understand the Emotional circuit of brain in R-project
parts:
Hello

I had proposed an idea for the project"interactive animations for
exploring high dimensional time series data"

Proposal :-

A qualia structure is a n-dimensional structure that is very useful in
studying behavior of dynamic systems like human brain , fuel and
financial markets.Generally a f-MRI scan/ other bio-metric measures
are used to study
Emotional circuit of brain. This has been the most recent research
topic to understand how the emotional circuitry of brain works.

So by using a causal interactions among the various brain parts and
the related entropy with Lattice theory a graphical application in the
R-project can be developed that plots a Qualia structure and discusses
the interaction among the relevant parts of the brain in generating a
human stimuli.

I regret i could n't discuss the idea for time - limitations and thus
couldn't explain the proposal in a proper manner. I request mentors to
consider this project and comment on it's potential.
